text: Looking into the relativedelta float-addition bug now; I'll have a fix and verification in about 10 minutes.
Got it — investigating the rrule count=0 bug (an rrule with count=0 should yield zero occurrences). ETA ~10 minutes.
#1 (relativedelta float addition): still in progress, fix + verification ETA ~6 minutes.
#2 (rrule count=0): still in progress, fix + verification ETA ~8 minutes.
On it — investigating the rrule `__str__` / RRULE token bug. ETA ~10 minutes.

#2 fixed: rrule now treats count=0 as "zero occurrences" instead of ignoring it (the `_iter` loop used truthiness on `self._count`, so count=0 became infinite). `list(rrule(DAILY, count=0, dtstart=...))` is now `[]`, `count() == 0`, and `str()` round-trips `COUNT=0`. Full test suite still passes (1064 passed, 43 skipped, same as baseline).

#4 fixed: `rrule.__str__` now appends the `RRULE:` token, so `str(rrule(DAILY, count=1, dtstart=datetime(2020,1,1)))` returns `DTSTART:20200101T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1` (and round-trips through `rrulestr`). Full test suite still green (1064 passed, 43 skipped).
On it — investigating the parser `fuzzy_with_tokens` bug. ETA ~10 minutes.

#8 fixed: `relativedelta.__abs__` was missing entirely (so `abs(relativedelta(...))` raised TypeError). Added it; now `abs(relativedelta(days=-1)) == relativedelta(days=+1)` and `datetime(2000,1,1) + abs(relativedelta(days=-1)) == datetime(2000,1,2)`. Full suite green (1064 passed, 43 skipped).
#1 (relativedelta float addition): fix in progress; the subagent is still working on `__add__`/`__radd__` float handling. ETA ~3 minutes.
